svg.title: Exercise 1-4: exact current and absorbed-power waveforms
svg.desc: i is 10t amperes for zero to one second, zero from one to two, minus five from two to three; absorbed power is minus twenty t watts, zero, then ten watts. Corner derivatives are not assigned: open circles show one-sided limits. A zero-charge continuation is shown after three seconds.

g.aria-label: Current and absorbed power, u = −2 V
g.title: Current and absorbed power, u = −2 V
g.desc: Mathematical notation: Current and absorbed power, u=-2\,\mathrm{V}

g.text: Open circles: one-sided limits. Dashed lines: jumps, not impulses.
